title: Sign-in groups from Cloudron
summary: Your intranet role now comes from your Cloudron groups when you sign in. The footer version shows a plain version number, without a development build suffix.

added: Sign-in uses your Cloudron groups to set your intranet role, so access stays in step with Cloudron.
changed: The footer version pill shows the plain published version (for example v0.6.19), without a +dev build suffix.
fixed: Development previews no longer show a confusing +dev commit suffix on the version pill.
